postcard.title: The dessert
postcard.note: Best dessert in Crete isn’t baklava. It’s watermelon, melon, and a raki you didn’t order. Arkadi, Georgioupolis.
postcard.caption: Best dessert in Crete isn’t baklava. It’s watermelon, melon, and a raki you didn’t order. Arkadi, Georgioupolis.

word.meaning: Cretan raki. It arrives with the fruit, and that is the dessert.
